source_title: Harry Styles’ ‘Harryween’ Tickets Are Still Available — Here’s How to Find Deals
source_excerpt:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Rolling Stone may receive an affiliate commission.
Harry Styles ’ 2026 Together, Together global tour is nearing the end of its U.S. run, with the final shows taking place at Madison Square Garden on Oct. 30 and 31, 2026. The massive trek celebrates his fourth studio album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally , and will officially wrap up Dec. 13 in Australia.
But for fans in NYC who still want to see the superstar live this weekend, there’s one more reason to get excited: Harryween.
The Halloween-themed event dates back to 2021, and you never quite know what Styles and his band will bring to the stage. Whether they’re dressing up as characters from Grease or going full Wizard of Oz , the costumes are part of the fun (and his fans never disappoint when it comes to their own creations, either).
Tickets for these special shows have been disappearing fast, but we’re breaking down the top ways to find tickets that are still available , along with tips, deals, and discounts to help you score some of the best seats in the house.
At a Glance: How to Buy Harry Styles ‘Harryween’ MSG Tickets
Best Prices: StubHub , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Ticketmaster , Gametime
The Together, Together Tour comes nearly three years after Styles’ Love on Tour , which grossed more than $615 million. This time around, commentators have praised everything from the singer’s vocals to his endurance.
How to Buy Harry Styles ‘Harryween’ MSG Tickets Online, Best Prices, Deals
Over on Reddit, some concertgoers have shared their frustration with how quickly Harryween tickets sold out. But if you already have your costume ready and are hoping to catch Styles at MSG on Oct. 30 or 31, there’s still time to snag a seat. We found last-minute tickets starting at around $600 on trusted resale sites like StubHub, Vivid Seats, and SeatGeek.
Right now, seats on StubHub are starting around $690 for Oct. 30. The website notes that tickets are selling quickly.
Over on Vivid Seats, we’re seeing listings starting at $540 for upper-level seats at Madison Square Garden. Readers can use Rolling Stone’s exclusive code RS30 to get $30 off orders of $300 or more.
Buy Harry Styles Tickets on TicketNetwork
TicketNetwork is one of our favorite resale platforms because it offers flexible payment options like Affirm, allowing fans to pay in installments instead of all at once. This can make attending Harryween more manageable without the upfront cost. Plus, readers can also save $150 on orders of $500 or more with code RS150.
SeatGeek, meanwhile, is showing some of the more affordable resale prices, with tickets for Harryween starting at $600+. The platform also offers parking passes, though public transportation is strongly recommended when heading into New York City. Use code ROLLINGSTONE10 for $10 off orders of $250 or more.
Meanwhile, GameTime tickets are selling quickly, but the platform still has options ranging from close-to-the-stage seats to more affordable upper-level sections. And honestly, at Madison Square Garden, there isn’t a bad seat in the house.
Harry Styles ’ Harryween concerts take place Oct. 30 and 31 at Madison Square Garden, with the singer expected to take the stage around 9 p.m.
